Name: Setup checklist
I Want To: see the setup steps that must be finished before my team logs in
So That: I can finish setup without opening a support ticket
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Admin sees required steps
Given a new workspace with no completed steps
When the admin opens setup
Then the required steps are listed in order

Scenario: Completed step is marked
Given the admin has invited one teammate
When the admin returns to setup
Then the invite step shows as complete

Name: Resume setup later
I Want To: leave setup and come back to the same step
So That: I do not lose progress when I am interrupted
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Progress is kept
Given the admin completed two steps
When the admin signs out and back in
Then setup opens at the third step

Name: Single sign-on step
I Want To: connect our identity provider during setup
So That: my team signs in with company accounts from day one
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Admin connects the identity provider
Given the admin has identity provider metadata
When the admin uploads it
Then a test sign-in succeeds
